sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-95.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 95 was established by Ordinance No. 15618, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 28, 1977. Ordinance No. 15618 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the 1960 Revised Code of Civil and Criminal Ordinances of the City of Dallas. Ordinance No. 15618 was amended by Resolution No. 78-1230, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 3, 1978; Ordinance No. 16652, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 6, 1980; Resolution No. 80-2138, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 6, 1980; Resolution No. 80-2558, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 17, 1980; Ordinance No. 17565, passed by the Dallas City Council on October 6, 1982; Resolution No. 84-1008, passed by the Dallas City Council on March 14, 1984; Ordinance No. 18248, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 2, 1984; and Ordinance No. 18841, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 14, 1985. Ordinance No. 18248 rezoned a portion of PD 95 located at the southwest corner of Caruth Haven Lane and North Central Expressway to PD 176. Ordinance No. 18841 rezoned a portion of PD 95 located at the northwest corner of Southwestern Boulevard and North Central Expressway to PD 209. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 15618; 16652; 17565; 18248; 18841; 25423; Res. No. 78-1230; 80-2138; 80-2558; 84-1008)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-95.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 95 is established on property generally located at the northeast corner of Southwestern Boulevard and Boedeker Street. The size of PD 95 is approximately 51.655 acres. (Ord. Nos. 15618; 16652; 18248; 18841; 25423)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-95.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25423)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-95.104.CONCEPTUAL PLAN. A conceptual plan, as approved by the city council on June 4, 1980, is labelled Exhibit 95A. (Ord. Nos. 16652; 25423)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-95.105.DEVELOPMENT PLAN.
(a)Development within the Phase I area must be in accordance with the lot arrangement and street location indicated on the approved conceptual plan attached to Ordinance No. 15618 (Exhibit 95B), with setbacks to be provided in accordance with those established on the recorded subdivision plat.
(b)A detailed development plan must be submitted and approved by the city plan commission, signed by the director of development services, and attested by the chair of the city plan commission on each subsequent phase of development prior to the issuance of the building permit within that phase.
(c)Each approved development plan must be attached to and made a part of Ordinance 15618, as amended, through resolution of the city council.
(d)Development within this PD must be in accordance with the approved development plans. [A development plan for Phases II through VI is labelled Exhibit 95C.] (Ord. Nos. 15618; 16652; 25423; Res. 84-1008)

sections.title: Subdivision Plat
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-95.106.SUBDIVISION PLAT.
(a)Within the designated Phase I area, the property presently dedicated as a street must be platted as a lot, and the property presently platted as a lot to be used as a street intersecting with Southwestern Boulevard must be dedicated as a street through the subdivision process.
(b)Other than the designated Phase I area, a preliminary plat must be submitted to the city plan commission for each subsequent phase of development, indicating the proposed lot arrangement for each individual phase and the street circulation pattern for the entire site within the boundaries of the PD. Prior to the issuance of a building permit within each phase of development other than the designated Phase I area, a final plat must be approved by the city plan commission and filed for record with the county clerk’s office. (Ord. Nos. 15618; 25423)

sections.title: Uses And Development
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-95.107.USES AND DEVELOPMENT. Uses permitted within this PD must be in accordance with the following provisions:
(1)No uses other than single-family detached and attached dwelling units and private community centers are permitted.
(2)The total density of the residential area may not exceed 308 units, and no front, side, or rear yards are required except as otherwise noted on the approved subdivision plats.
(3)Residential lots within this area may not exceed the following standards:
(A)Minimum lot size: 3,250 square feet.
(B)Minimum lot width: 35 feet.
(C)Minimum lot depth: 65 feet.
(D)Minimum living area: 1,500 square feet.
(E)Maximum height: 2 1/2 stories (30 feet).
(F)Maximum lot coverage: 80 percent of an individual lot may be covered by all buildings or structures, provided that within the total project coverage does not exceed 60 percent. (Ord. Nos. 16652; 25423)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-95.108.PARKING.
(a)Parking for single-family detached dwellings must be provided at a ratio of two off-street parking spaces for each dwelling unit. Parking for single-family attached units must be provided at a ratio of three off-street parking spaces for each dwelling unit, one of which may be located on a public common area as defined on the approved development plan and the approved subdivision plat.
(b)Parking for the private community centers must be provided as indicated on the approved development plan.
(c)A parking space must be at least 10 feet from the right-of-way line adjacent to a street or alley if the space is located in an enclosed structure and if the space faces upon or can be entered directly from the street or alley. (Ord. Nos. 17565; 25423)

sections.title: Ingress-Egress
sections.text: SEC. 51P-95.109.INGRESS-EGRESS. All means of ingress and egress to property within the boundaries of this PD must be approved by the department of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 15618; 25423)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-95.110.SIGNS. All signs must comply with the non-business category of Chapter 41 of the 1960 Revised Code of Civil and Criminal Ordinances of the city. (Ord. Nos. 15618; 25423; 26102)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text: SEC. 51P-95.111.SCREENING. A solid screening wall with a minimum height of six feet must be constructed as shown on the conceptual plan. The wall may be set back from the property line to allow for existing trees or other desirable vegetation and the said site plan does not does not need to show said setbacks. The wall may be a part of a building or structure as long as it acts as a screen. Further, a chain link fence will be permitted in lieu of solid screening or exterior walls in tennis court and swimming pool areas as long as a cover is placed on said fence to act as a visual screen. (Ord. Nos. 15618; 25423)

sections.title: Homeowners’ Association
sections.text: SEC. 51P-95.112.HOMEOWNERS’ ASSOCIATION. Common open areas in any subdivision within this PD must be maintained by a homeowners’ association. The instrument creating the homeowners’ association must be approved by the city attorney’s office, submitted to the city plan commission in conjunction with the platting of the property, and filed for record in the Deed Records of Dallas County, Texas. (Ord. Nos. 15618; 25423)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-95.113.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS. Development of this property must be in compliance with the requirements of all departments of the city. (Ord. Nos. 15618; 25423)

sections.title: Streets And Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-95.114.STREETS AND PAVING.
(a)Paving for all public streets, auto courts, and parking areas must comply with the specifications and requirements of the department of public works and transportation.
(b)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 15618; 25423; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-95.115.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. No certificate of occupancy may be issued by the building official until there has been full compliance with this article and any applicable provisions of the zoning ordinance and the building codes. (Ord. Nos. 15618; 25423)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-95.116.ZONING MAP. PD 95 is located on Zoning Map No. G-8. (Ord. Nos. 16652; 25423)
